metadata.description: FORTRESS — build what can't be taken. The defensive half of Maverick's Monkey Werx.

plugins.name: fortress
plugins.description: Hold it. Guerrilla marketing for the Proof Economy — build what can't be taken. A claim register with a real linter that fails on unsourced claims, flags a source nobody has re-checked, and catches copy still carrying a claim you withdrew. Plus motte-and-bailey asset sorting, account standing, and a human publish gate.
